reasoning_checks: All supplied entity, dates, units, timing, tax and measurement assumptions matched between inputs, fragment, README and benchmark. Forecast conditions are hypothetical and do not claim observed October2026 results.

Opening assets350 equal debt120 plus payable40 plus equity190. All historical transactions are supplied, preserve each journal balance and close into draft assets458 or corrected assets438 with actual cash28.

Maintenance evidence describes consumed routine services, not a qualifying replacement or inspection. The two correction entries remove20 PPE and5 DTL; tax deduction and cash payment already occurred, so cash and current tax do not change. The correction is of an unissued draft, not a freely selected earnings policy.

Forecasts begin at corrected historical balances; sales, purchases, collections, supplier cash and working capital are separate routes. Interest is10% of opening interest-bearing debt; final-date borrowings, capital expenditure, repayment and share issuance do not silently alter the stated annual interest/depreciation timing.

Current tax expense, opening payable and tax cash reconcile. Historical genuine capex enters service in the forecast and contributes12 depreciation; old assets contribute40; closing forecast expenditure starts service next year.

Base net income66.75, CFO111.25, ending revolver35.75 and assets516 reconcile. Adverse income33 and CFO-3.5 remain unchanged through financing repairs. Unfunded plans return explicit gaps without an asserted feasible closing balance sheet or invented financing cash.

The initial adverse75.5 funding gap measures distance to the25 cash minimum, not only the50.5 negative-cash amount. Dividend/capex actions save50; the minimum conditional subscription25.5 then funds the endpoint with revolver75 and cash25.

Repaired CFO-3.5, CFI-50 and CFF50.5 produce cash change-3, from28 to25. Equity287 comprises share capital125.5 and retained161.5;8.5 new thousand shares produce17/217 new ownership, not an asserted fair value.

Full subscription30 uses10 new thousand shares, new owner fraction1/11 and ending revolver70.5. The4.5 remaining line capacity supports closing receivables172.5 (23/112 of sales); one additional receivable requires unauthorized funding and fails the cash minimum.

Declared current-liability and all-cash-excluded invested-capital definitions reconcile to financing claims. ROE, asset turnover and DuPont use the same endpoint averages; ROIC uses hypothetical after-tax EBIT and explicit operating capital. Final-date issuance and investment limit economic interpretation of simple averages.

Six requested deliverables align with the complete instructor numerical guide and100-point criterion rubric. Alternative conditional decisions are graded on funding, evidence and reasoning; missing evidence cannot be replaced by assertions of fraud, permissible normalization or universal ratio thresholds.

All mandatory methods are taught in accepted Volume7 chapters. The source passages support scoped distinctions and planning principles; they do not certify current reporting compliance, real financing approval or subjective management intent.

limitations: Synthetic contract and documentary premises are supplied for teaching; no actual company, legal/tax opinion, securities valuation, financing approval or fraud finding is certified.
Annual endpoint solvency and liquidity do not establish the within-year cash path, future covenant availability, lender renewal or operational feasibility without dated additional evidence.

The benchmark is limited to this standalone ordinary-equity distributor with the supplied book/tax and asset conventions; it is not a general loss-tax, consolidation, lease, FX or financial-reporting engine.
Endpoint-average ratios are accounting diagnostics and require contextual comparison; no universal threshold, causal attribution or institutional acceptance is implied.
Authored time and scoring guidance are not empirically calibrated. Agent review is not independent human evaluation or a guarantee of error-free work.
Browser/mobile/print visual QA is separate and remains pending at library level; coordinator owns assembly, final structural verification, acceptance and publication.
